lines.text: The LORD became jealous for His land, spared His people, and promised them grain, new wine, and oil.
The LORD would drive the northern army into a barren land, its front ranks into the Dead Sea.
The land and the beasts of the field were told not to fear, because the open pastures had turned green.
The LORD gave the children of Zion autumn and spring rains and promised to repay the years eaten by locusts.
The people would praise the LORD, who worked wonders, and would know He is present in Egypt.
